notes.title: Oculus rift support now available!
notes.content:
And when I say available, i mean that it was there the whole time, i just didn't know about it. Like, how often do you make a game for one thing and then it just works on another thing without you even doing anything about it? That almost never happens. But i guess it did now.

I waited till I could confirm it for myself to change the compatibility settings on this page. But there you go. The game works best with a 360 setup but you can probably try it without.

Ok, Thanks to everyone who played it so far! If anyone has any feedback, feel free to reach out at @MGnolas on twitter, or email MadGnolas@gmail.com. Too hard? too easy? too weird controls? Let me know!

Ok, imma go play some more Grand Theft Horsey Time 2 now. Bye!
